concept.title: Health advice and treatment support
concept.shortdesc: Advice, information and support on health matters including medication, sexual health, substance use, nutrition and healthy lifestyle changes.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Help taking, managing or obtaining medication and prescriptions, including support to reduce harm from prescription drugs.
: Support, groups, advice and harm reduction for people dealing with drug, alcohol or gambling problems.
: Testing, treatment, contraception, information and advice on sexual health and related conditions.
: Advice, information and guidance on health, healthy living and health services, including advice from health professionals.
: Support, coaching and education on diet, nutrition, healthy weight, stopping smoking and making healthy lifestyle changes.
